final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT il.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(il.product_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(1.0 * (il.derived_product_cost - il.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(il.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS il JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = il.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY il.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3
